The main takeaway from our work is that
fact lookup is a challenging task and it requires a system to address the entire pipeline from crawling to ranking, as well as the integration of various technologies.
it is possible to build an accurate fact lookup engine with a small team, using existing technologies and novel approaches.
a fact lookup engine is not only a search engine for structured data, but also a search engine for unstructured data.
